tools.unsupported: This operation is outside the tool’s supported scope.
tools.convergence: The method could not produce a result within its bounds.
tools.engineUnavailable: The tool engine could not start. Retry the calculation or reload DARS.

scientific.title: Scientific
scientific.description: Trigonometry, logarithms, complex numbers and configurable precision.
scientific.keyboardHint: Use Enter to calculate, Shift+Enter for a new line and Escape to cancel.
scientific.precisionError: Enter a working precision from 8 to 80 digits.

algebra.title: Algebra
algebra.description: Rewrite expressions, solve equations and check candidate solutions.
algebra.keyboardHint: Use Ctrl+Enter or ⌘+Enter to calculate and Escape to cancel.
algebra.rejected: Candidate is outside the solution set
algebra.allReal: Every real x is a solution
algebra.allComplex: Every complex x is a solution

hints.simplify: Enter a rational expression in x, y or z. Excluded values appear with the answer.
hints.expand: Use parentheses to group factors and ^ to enter powers.
hints.factor: Enter a polynomial in one variable with rational coefficients.
hints.polynomial: The result lists coefficients from highest to lowest degree.
hints.solve: Enter an equation in one variable and choose the solution domain.
hints.inequality: Enter an inequality in one variable using <, ≤, > or ≥.
hints.system: Place each linear equation on a new line or separate equations with semicolons.
hints.substitute: Enter the expression first, followed by assignments separated by semicolons.
hints.verify: Enter the equation first, followed by candidate assignments separated by semicolons.

operations.offlineUnavailable: The offline cache is unavailable or still preparing.
operations.offlineError: The requested offline setting could not be confirmed.
operations.localeUnavailable: This language could not be loaded. Use a downloaded language or allow static downloads.
operations.storageNote: Expressions, history and saved values live in this session. Explicit preferences stay on this device.
operations.cachedAssetsNote: Clear downloaded web assets using this site's storage controls in your browser.
operations.permissionNote: Copying uses the clipboard after your action. Battery state is optional when the browser makes it available. This version requests no account, location or credentials.
operations.networkNote: The web build uses its own origin for static files. It sends no calculations, diagnostics or telemetry.
operations.policyNote: Profiles tune resource use. Mathematical precision stays the same.
operations.diagnosticNote: These are local readings. Browser memory and scheduling values cover only the reported scope.
operations.nativeSensorNote: Desktop readings stay on this device. Host counters cover the app process alone.
